overall: The AG found no evidence of improper Board deliberation on the contract revision, but found a violation because the chair responded individually to a complaint without Board review and without notifying the AG.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board improperly deliberated outside a posted meeting about revising a draft contract with the regional school committee.
allegations.key_passage: We do not find evidence to support the assertion that a quorum of the Board improperly deliberated about the revision to the draft contract.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board did not comply with the Open Meeting Law in responding to his April 12, 2013 complaint, which the chair answered individually before any Board review.
allegations.key_passage: Mr. Bollard individually responded to the complaint by letter, prior to any review by the Board, and failed to provide our office with a copy of this response.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law; future similar conduct may be considered evidence of intent to violate.
remedy_passage: We therefore order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that future similar conduct may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
